title: Customer net worth
statementMd:
Total balance per customer across all their accounts (rounded to 2 decimals). Top five, ties by name.

Expected columns: `name`, `balance`.

Tables: `customers`, `accounts`, `transactions`.

**Row order matters** for this problem.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT c.name, ROUND(SUM(t.amount), 2) AS balance FROM customers c JOIN accounts a ON a.customer_id = c.id JOIN transactions t ON t.account_id = a.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY balance DESC, c.name LIMIT 5;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
